notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying {1}{W}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Momentary Blink, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
